title: pvFluentCFFCaseReader
body:
## pvFluentCFFCaseReader

Reads ANSYS Fluent results in the HDF5-based Common Fluids Format: the case file (.cas.h5) and, automatically, the data file of the same name (.dat.h5). The output is a multiblock dataset of unstructured grids with cell-centred solution fields. Several case files form a time series. Use pvFluentCaseReader for the legacy .cas/.dat format.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- If the matching .dat.h5 is missing, only the mesh is read (VTK warns); keep both files together with the same base name.
- Fields are cell data; use cellToPoint before operations that need point data.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `FluentCFFCaseReader`. Identity: `sources/FLUENTCFFReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of the cell-centred solution fields to read from the .dat.h5 file (for example pressure, velocity or temperature as named by Fluent). Listing names is exclusive: ParaView switches every other available name off, so include all you need; an empty list reads none. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The name of the files to load. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvFluentCFFCaseReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
